{{Quote|Even in the absence of physical proof, he's invoked Directive Four-Seventeen, requesting the support of all nearby Imperial forces.|Captain Voss Parck, to Lord Odo|<ref name="Choices">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>}}
'''Directive Four-Seventeen''' requested the support of all [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] forces close by.<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Imperial [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kauf Ularno]] invoked the directive after an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] [[Battle for Poln Major|attempt]] on the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]], [[Bidor Ferrouz]], forcing the nearby [[Task Force Admonitor|Task Force ''Admonitor'']] to assist.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
Directive Four-Seventeen appeared in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]'', which was written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Choices" />
